description: Erection of a rear extension at second floor level on top of the existing back addition, following partial demolition of the existing rear roof extension; installation of 3no. rooflights in the front roofslope, following the removal of existing rooflights.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposal would not constitute an enlargement which joins the original roof to the roof of a rear or side extension, as the original rear roof slope has been removed and the proposed addition would attach to a previous rear roof extension. The original eaves have been obliterated and cannot be maintained or reinstated, and the development would not provide the required 0.2m set back, failing to comply with part B.2(b)(i)(aa) and (bb) of Class B. Therefore, the proposed works would fail to meet the criteria for permitted development under Class B, Part 1, Schedule 2, Article 3 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).

Reason : 2 - The proposal would not constitute an enlargement which joins the original roof to the roof of a rear or side extension, as the original rear roof slope and rear eaves have been removed and replaced by a previous rear roof extension. The proposed addition would be attached to the existing rear roof extension rather than the original roof form of the dwellinghouse. Therefore, the proposal would fail to comply with Part B.2(b)(ii) of Class B and would fail to meet the criteria for permitted development under Class B, Part 1, Schedule 2, Article 3 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
